must_identify.item: The old pods are still serving (rollout stuck, not an outage)

notes: The RCA never says the old ReplicaSet is still serving. Its Service finding ('Service has not ready endpoints... cannot route traffic') implies an outage and misattributes it to readiness probe or app startup issues. No commands were recorded, so the output looks like an unfiltered automated analyzer dump; a reviewer should confirm the actual Service endpoint state.
